answer: Give every agent identity a reputation that can only be earned slowly, like a falcon trained over seasons rather than bought in a day: a newcomer starts on the lowest terrace of trust with tiny transaction limits and climbs only through peer-attested useful work. Sybils then face the same cost as building a tower to the zenith one stone at a time - each fake identity must pay real time and stake before it can profit, which costs more than one scam returns. Cheap identities stay visible, slow, and unprofitable.
